notes.title: Source Port Update #5 is available now!
notes.content:
Hello Hackers,

A new update for System Shock: Enhanced Edition is available now on Windows which includes the following fixes and improvements:

Version 1.2.16 (2021-01-22):
[list][*]Fixed crash when user path uses non-ASCII characters.
[*]Fixed random crashes on some user setups (when a frame is rendered without the corresponding physics frame is run due to timing issues).
[*]Fixed vanishing automap notes after saving/loading.
[*]Fixed AI getting stuck on some corners.
[/list]
Salt the fries!

-Daniel,
Nightdive Studios.

We hope you enjoy the update!

Daniel,
Nightdive Studios.

notes.title: Source Port Update #1 is available now!
notes.content:
Greetings Hackers,

A new patch is out now for System Shock Enhanced Edition that fixes the following issues:

Version 1.1.5 (2018-09-13):
[list]
[*]Increased maximum 3D points from 256 to 1024 in order to prevent random renderer crashes.
[*] Moved writable files to Application Roaming Data folder (missions, languages, mods, kexengine.cfg, mods.cfg and CRASHLOG.TXT).
[*] Added show_string console command for developer mode.
[*] Enabled starting the game without Steam running on background by using "-no-social" command-line argument (Steam version only).
[*] Fixed brackets and question mark key commands (now named left_brack, right_brack and question_mark).
[*] Fixed lockup in item cycle selection when player doesn't have any item of a given class (software, patches and grenades).
[*] Fixed "Press a key" message positioning on key binding menu.
[*] Removed unused game thread.
[*] Fixed crash when music file path contains more than 64 characters.
[*] Fixed sliders minimum/maximum values in menus, now preventing user from increasing values past maximum when using left and right direction keys.
[*] Fixed crash when loading games with MFD bio status exposed in full screen mode.
[*] Fixed crash when double-clicking executable outside Steam desktop app (Steam version only).
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the update. Please let us know of any problems in the forums!

Happy Hacking!

-Daniel
Nightdive Studios

notes.title: "The Source Port Update" is available now!
notes.content:
For the first time ever, System Shock has been rebuilt from the original source code as a FREE update to all owners of the game!

System Shock: Enhanced Edition features:
-------------------------------------------------------
[list][*]Higher resolution support up to 4K widescreen mode
[*]Mouselook support
[*]Rebindable keyboard/mouse/joystick commands
[*]Adapted to Nightdive's KEX engine
[*]Support for both Direct3D and OpenGL
[*]Option to switch between hi-resolution Mac assets and the original DOS assets
[*]Official support for fan missions and fan mods
[*]New unified options menu that allows changing preferences before gameplay
[*]Adjustable FOV (Field of View)
[*]Smoother camera rotation and translation
[*]Improved control scheme which allows faster and streamlined experience
[*]Brand new achievements
[*]In-Game remappable keys with three profiles to choose from: original controls, custom controls, and lefthanded controls.
[*]Many original game bugs fixed.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this free update for System Shock: Enhanced Edition!

Feel free to let us know what you think about it in the forums. We'll be monitoring it a lot over the next few weeks or so to gather information.

Enjoy the update, and keep the fries salted!

-Daniel
Nightdive Studios.
